breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.0001 with 12000 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=1.
breakdown.reason: The agent kept 12000 steps with dt=1e-4 and incorrectly claimed this reaches T=1.0. In reality, dt=1e-4 × 12000 = 1.2, not 1.0. The ground truth corrects this to 10000 steps (dt=1e-4 × 10000 = 1.0). The agent failed to resolve this inconsistency.
